questions.q: How is Account Inspector connected to Account Monitor?
options: They are unrelated, separate modules
Account Inspector is fully integrated with Account Monitor, so a flagged account can be opened directly in Account Inspector carrying the same context
Account Inspector replaces Account Monitor entirely
Account Inspector only works with budget data, not actuals
questions.explain: Account Inspector is integrated with Account Monitor so users can move from a flagged line directly into deeper analysis of that same account.

questions.q: What makes Account Inspector different from a flat balance inquiry?
options: It behaves like an online, multidimensional pivot table, letting a balance be sliced by multiple chart of accounts segments
It can only show one account at a time with no further detail
It cannot be used until a period is closed
It only displays data in text form, never charts
questions.explain: Account Inspector supports pivoting, slicing, and charting across dimensions, unlike a single flat balance lookup.

questions.q: In the LTV Manufacturing Corporation example, pivoting the $16,940 Travel & Entertainment balance by cost center shows what?
options: The overage is spread evenly across every cost center
$11,200 of the total sits in the Sales cost center alone, concentrating the issue in one department
The balance disappears once pivoted
Pivoting has no effect on the displayed total
questions.explain: Pivoting reveals that most of the overage is concentrated in Sales, reframing the investigation toward that specific department.

questions.q: From Account Inspector, which further actions are possible on the data?
options: None, it is a read-only dead end
Only exporting to a spreadsheet
Viewing the data as a chart and drilling in either direction, including down to journal lines and subledger transactions
Only changing the chart of accounts structure
questions.explain: Account Inspector supports charting the data and drilling from any parent or child level down to detail balances, journal lines, and subledger transactions.

questions.q: Which tool is the right choice when a user already knows the exact account and just wants the number?
options: Account Inspector
Account Monitor
Inquire on Detail Balances
Journal Approvals
questions.explain: Inquire on Detail Balances is for a direct, known lookup; Account Monitor is for ongoing automatic flagging, and Account Inspector is for slicing a flagged or suspicious balance.
